sloka: स शरैराहतस्तेन सरोषो रावणात्मजः।सुप्रयुक्तैस्त्रिभिर्बाणैः प्रतिविव्याध लक्ष्मणम् ।। ६.८८.३२ ।।
transliteration: sa śarairāhatastena saroṣo rāvaṇātmajaḥ।suprayuktaistribhirbāṇaiḥ prativivyādha lakṣmaṇam ।। 6.88.32 ।।

translations.english: Struck by the arrows, Indrajith in return furiously released three well aimed arrows at Lakshmana.
